$Comment: Does nothing, on purpose. A titan's chests, doors, bed and benches are all handled by TitanFixtureSystem off the UseEntityEvent that fires before this runs, so by the time the interaction chain gets here the work is already done.

It exists because the chain will not start without it. UseEntityInteraction fails outright when the target carries no interaction id for the type, and RootInteraction rejects an empty Interactions list, so a fixture needs something on the far end of the click even when the answer is 'nothing'. A no-op is also what keeps the client's prompt honest: the block still lights up and still shows its hint.
RunTime 0 so the chain finishes in the same tick and the player is not left mid-interaction while a chest window opens over the top of it.
